scope.description: Mapped polygons associated through existing atlas map IDs entity-turkey in the 1938 boundary snapshot. This measures the displayed mapped extent, not an official contemporary statistic or all territory claimed by the polity.

No geometry repair, historical ownership or official statistical assertion. Raw computed area 498350.9817601693 km2; 1 source features. pyproj 3.7.2; Shapely 2.1.2. qualifications: Derived mapped/geometric area, not an official contemporary historical area statistic.
